title: Ada and the Salt
author: Petra Voss
blurb: Cyrus Marchetti, an exiled storm-caller, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
